title: Use platform security capabilities as architectural building blocks: concept decisions 2
teachingQuestion: Which platform capability protects this layer, and what assumption must still hold?
focalInsight: Capabilities protect bounded layers and rely on keys, configuration, administration, and operation.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Privileged Account Management
nodes.definition: Control of high-authority accounts through attributable, limited, protected administration.
nodes.detail: Control of high-authority accounts through attributable, limited, protected administration.
nodes.decision: Require unique identities, strong authentication, scope, review, and emergency handling.
nodes.failureExample: A shared root account makes a destructive configuration change untraceable.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Privilege needs accountable identity and constrained authority.
